title: Semi-Supervised GAN-Based Segmentation of CTPA Scans for Pulmonary Emboli Boundary Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2611.24018v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pulmonary embolism (PE) is a pulmonary vascular disease associated with high morbidity and mortality, where delayed diagnosis can be fatal. While computed tomography pulmonary angiography (CTPA) is the clinical gold standard for PE detection, interpreting these scans manually is time-consuming and error-prone. In this work, we propose a semi-supervised segmentation method, employing generative adversarial networks (GANs) to leverage large pools of unlabeled CTPA scans. The proposed method addresses more effectively the challenges of CTPA image segmentation than previous methods by employing the dice loss and the cross-entropy loss to tackle the highly imbalanced nature of CTPA scans, the feature matching loss to encourage the generator to produce anatomically plausible segmentation maps that are indistinguishable from ground truth, as well as the self-training loss to reinforce learning from highly-confident pseudo-labeled samples. translated_title: 基于半监督生成对抗网络的CTPA扫描分割方法用于肺栓塞边界提取
translated_abstract: 肺栓塞（PE）是一种具有高发病率和死亡率的肺血管疾病，延误诊断可能致命。虽然计算机断层扫描肺动脉造影（CTPA）是PE检测的临床金标准，但人工解读这些扫描图像既耗时又容易出错。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种半监督分割方法，利用生成对抗网络（GAN）来充分利用大量未标记的CTPA扫描数据。所提出的方法通过以下方式比以往方法更有效地解决了CTPA图像分割的挑战：采用Dice损失和交叉熵损失来应对CTPA扫描高度不平衡的特性；采用特征匹配损失来鼓励生成器产生在解剖学上合理、且与真实标注难以区分的分割图；以及采用自训练损失来强化对高置信度伪标签样本的学习。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于半监督生成对抗网络的CTPA扫描分割方法，通过组合Dice损失、交叉熵损失、特征匹配损失和自训练损失，有效解决了CTPA图像高度不平衡和标注数据稀缺的问题，实现肺栓塞边界的自动提取。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a semi-supervised GAN-based segmentation method for CTPA scans that combines dice loss, cross-entropy loss, feature matching loss, and self-training loss to effectively handle the highly imbalanced nature of CTPA images and leverage unlabeled data for pulmonary emboli boundary extraction.
